findings_contract: No reproduced product safety defect in this changed scope. A concrete defect would include severity, file:line, reproduction, violated invariant and remedy; absence here is not a universal absence proof.

acceptance.requirement: Only the authenticated CURRENT owner can wait without an idle first-byte deadline
acceptance.review: SO_PEERCRED precedes loop. _validate precedes owner claim. Authentication and owner claim are synchronous before command_lock's first await. Both authenticated and identity-equal owner_writer are required by the new branch. Only claim and authenticated-finally release assign owner_writer.
acceptance.evidence: Independent real UDS overlapping two valid status requests yields exactly one winner; loser Stop denied; loser retains 2.5s unauthenticated timeout; closing loser does not release winner. Wrong peer and exclusive filesystem owner existing tests pass.

acceptance.requirement: No authentication/schema/type bypass and no effect or authority creation from idle or denial
acceptance.evidence: Independent same-wire negatives before and after ownership cover bool version/generation, float epoch, list/object op, integer/wrong capability, list/stale boot and extra field. Each denies with unchanged owner, zero grant/process/preparation/settings; valid status controls pass. Parser-level float denial correctly has id:null, unlike post-parse validation denial.

acceptance.requirement: Keep 2.5s started-frame budget, 2.5s total unauthenticated budget and MAX_FRAME=65536
acceptance.review: Authenticated owner reads exactly one byte, then one wait_for(readuntil,2.5), not per-byte waits. Newline-only is a complete invalid frame. Total assembled length is checked before parsing. Unauthenticated readuntil branch remains unchanged. No generic timeout extension.
acceptance.evidence: Existing affected UDS tests pass: no unsolicited wire byte through 2.8s idle, next RuntimeClient status correlates; exact MAX_FRAME accepted, MAX_FRAME+1 valid padded frame denied, oversized/unterminated frames denied, later partial bytes do not reset deadline, newline and EOF cases. One separately consumed byte can defer unterminated MAX_FRAME+1 refusal until the existing 2.5s body budget; it never accepts the oversized frame.

acceptance.requirement: Idle/partial transport cannot renew grants or prevent expiry/Stop/EOF/shutdown
acceptance.review: Watchdog remains separate with 0.025s period, authority ceiling remains 5s, writer drain remains 0.5s. First-byte wait does not acquire command_lock or alter deadline_ns. EOF reaches existing authenticated finally Stop. Host shutdown closes clients before wait_closed and joins handlers.
acceptance.evidence: Independent real synthetic child with 600ms lease exits while owned frame is stuck after first byte; PID absent, owned set empty, UNCERTAIN retained, original grant unchanged, 2.5s frame denial observed, subsequent status accepted and renew denied. Affected tests independently pass idle lease expiry, live child through 2.8s idle followed by Stop or EOF, saturated native pending slots, and authenticated/unauthenticated host shutdown.
